description: Resolves the named entities by canonical name, walks their 1-hop neighbourhood over knowledge_edge, and returns facts across seeds ∪ neighbours, optionally filtered by predicate hints. Works from entities named up front and returns what the graph holds around them ("who runs engineering at Acme" — the answer lives on a neighbour, not on Acme itself). Seeds score 1.0, neighbours 0.7; soft-fails to an empty result.

asOf.description: Valid-time as-of: facts true at this ISO 8601 moment (a retraction dated before it hides the fact; a fact learned after it still shows — not a knowledge snapshot)

entityNames.description: Canonical names of the entities to anchor on

predicateHints.description: Prefer facts with these predicates (non-matching neighbour facts are dropped, seed facts kept at lower score)

query.description: Free-text fallback used to resolve seeds when a name does not match exactly

name: graph_retrieve
title: Graph-first retrieval around named entities
